description: Three set-list filter patterns for the Svelte 5 data grid, all driven through api.setFacetFilter(columnId, values). The built-in column-menu facet covers static distinct values with typeahead, select all and clear; an async side panel fetches the value list from a mock endpoint with loading and retry, for columns whose distinct values are too many to load up front; and a tree picker for Region, Country and City cascades parent checkboxes to their descendants with a partial state.

faq.question: How do I apply a set of values as a filter from code?
faq.answer: Call api.setFacetFilter(columnId, ['EMEA', 'APAC']). Pass null to clear it. The built-in column menu facet uses the same call, so a custom panel and the menu stay consistent.

faq.question: What if a column has too many distinct values to list?
faq.answer: Load them on demand. The async panel here fetches the list from a mock server when it opens, shows a loading state and a retry on failure, and applies the checked values with setFacetFilter.

faq.question: How does the tree picker filter three columns at once?
faq.answer: Checking a region checks its countries and cities; the panel then derives the selected values per level and calls setFacetFilter for region, country and city.
